title: Formal Invariant Violation in counter module
description: A critical formal invariant violation was detected in the 'counter' module (CWE-1234) during Bounded Model Checking (BMC). This indicates a fundamental design flaw where a specified security property or invariant can be violated. The BMC step failure provides a concrete counterexample, demonstrating a path for an attacker to manipulate the counter's state, potentially leading to unauthorized access, denial of service, or incorrect system behavior.
